subject.title: add option for MCP apps support

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new MCP Apps executable-UI and app-to-server call boundary after current-head behavior proof is supplied?
rationale: The code applies strong isolation and limits, but allowing configured MCP servers to provide HTML and initiate app-visible tool or resource calls is an intentional product security decision that automated review cannot make.

options.title: Accept after current-head proof
options.body: Keep the default-off reduced-permission host and merge after a current-head recording proves rendering, calls, and cleanup.

options.title: Narrow the host further
options.body: Reduce bridge methods or rendering capabilities if the proposed trust boundary is broader than maintainers want to support.

options.title: Pause MCP Apps
options.body: Leave the feature unmerged until the executable-UI boundary and operational setup are simpler.

recommendation.title: Accept after current-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off reduced-permission host and merge after a current-head recording proves rendering, calls, and cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest implementation history and exact-head dependency approvals show active ownership of the feature and its security direction.
